title: Weather condition
description: Describes the weather from a temperature using half-open ranges.

data.question: Write a program that reads a temperature and prints Freezing weather below 0, Very Cold below 10, Cold below 20, Normal below 30, Hot below 40, otherwise Very Hot.

sections.body: Write a program that reads a temperature and prints Freezing weather below 0, Very Cold below 10, Cold below 20, Normal below 30, Hot below 40, otherwise Very Hot.

sections.heading: What the supplied code does
sections.body: Each upper bound is exclusive, so 10 is Very Cold, 20 is Cold, 30 is Normal and 40 is Hot.
